name: abs-for-real-tiktok
description: Abs For Real presale TikTok (Remotion): 29s + 15s vertical videos and thumbnail

scripts.render:long: remotion render src/index.ts AbsForRealLong out/abs-for-real-long.mp4 --codec h264
scripts.render:short: remotion render src/index.ts AbsForRealShort out/abs-for-real-short.mp4 --codec h264
scripts.render:all: npm run render:long && npm run render:short && npm run render:thumb
